chapter: Family follow-ups from the first reels
title: Father's birthdate and the St. Louis World's Fair
summary: Pinning down his father's birth around 1881 and the fair as the 1904 Louisiana Purchase Exposition.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: October 27th, 1977, and this is Reel 4 of the (inaudible) Marshal Royal. Marshal, in going back over the first three reels, I came up with a few questions. Among them, you mentioned that your father (inaudible) and so, I wanted to establish his birthdate and you say, what (inaudible)?
Yeah, he would be 98 this year, so if that figures it, that year.

And you mentioned that your band played at the St. Louis World's Fair and you weren't certain of the year and in checking for World's Fairs in St. Louis in the library, I found that there was an International Fair called the Louisiana Purchase Exhibit, which was an extremely large exhibit and fair, covering 1,240 acres and it was in 1904 in St. Louis. Do you think that was (inaudible)?
I know that the date had a four on the end of it. I didn't know whether it was '94 or 1904. But I'm pretty sure that it had a 4 on the end of it.
I see, but it definitely was St. Louis, because I (inaudible) --
-- checking, his friend Scott Joplin played at the Chicago World's Fair in 1893. That was something else entirely?
